title: Qunduz Bala Hisar
description: Qunduz Bala Hisar is the site of a fortified citadel in the Qunduz plain. The fortification is of oval shape, oriented on an East-West axis, with a high citadel at the eastern end.

properties.description: Representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
